item.title: Trump backs Nvidia boss's return but top Democrat vows probe
item.description: US President Donald Trump praised Nvidia's decision Monday to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive, as top Senate Democrat Chuck Schumer vowed to investigate potential wrongdoing amid mounting national security concerns. Trump also posted a doctored version of the famous photograph of him raising his fist after surviving a 2024 assassination attempt, replacing himself with Huang, who brandished a red bra beneath an Nvidia flag. FRANCE 24's Fraser Jackson reports from Washington.

item.title: How far will Ukraine war spread? Kyiv targets Russian vessels in Libya
item.description: Talk about spillover. In the Libyan port of Benghazi, Ukraine claiming responsibility for the sinkings first of a Russian warship and then a cargo vessel. That’s on top of the sanctioned ship struck in the Baltic Sea that’s since strayed into Finland’s waters. Legitimate targets?

item.title: Ukraine claims it sank Russian warship off Libya
item.description: Ukraine on Monday claimed it was behind strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya, including one that sank a modern warship, in the latest spillover from Moscow's invasion. The attacks on Sunday near the Libyan port of Benghazi come at a time when Ukraine has stepped up its daring strikes against Russia far from the frontlines in retaliation for Moscow's deadly invasion. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv.

item.title: Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO after Trump intervention
item.description: Nvidia on Monday reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive in a stunning reversal that President Donald Trump said followed his own direct contacts with the company's board. Huang resigned two weeks ago over an affair with a woman whom US intelligence agencies suspect of spying for China, a departure that sent Wall Street tumbling and stoked fears for a US economy reliant on the AI investment boom. FRANCE 24's Carys Garland and Wassim Cornet report.

item.title: 'Maintain control': UN chief calls for creation of global AI safety framework within a year
item.description: UN chief Antonio Guterres on Monday urged countries to agree on the creation of a global framework for managing the dangers posed by artificial intelligence within one year. Speaking at a summit in Barbados, he warned that taming the technology is vital if humanity is to stay in charge of its own future.
